items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: I had to go back to William Vachiano, who was the first trumpet player of the New York Philharmonic

ctx.x: Yeah, but I'm just thinking about playing, you know, being able to play. But I am worried about the mute, because this did turn me around a little because I was known to have a strong tone and everything, and in the band, and in the

bands it's high, really, like when you play the first parts, you know, because I had a nice strong tone. Now I come and I've got to close all that up, cover it up, you know. So -- but I enjoyed it. I didn't -- you know, after I got used to what I was doing. I had to go to a teacher again. I had to go back to William Vachiano, who was the first trumpet player of the New York Philharmonic, and I told him what I was doing and what I was up under, you know, because it got so my lip was getting tired, you know, doing…
